courses.title: UI/UX Design, Design Systems & AI Product Prototyping
courses.headline: Design Delightful, Accessible User Experiences with Figma, Design Systems & AI Tools
courses.shortDescription: Master user research, wireframing, Figma component libraries, responsive design systems, usability testing, and interactive mobile/web prototypes.
courses.fullDescription: Transform from a visual novice into an industry-ready UI/UX Product Designer. Learn modern design thinking methodologies, user empathy interviews, information architecture, Figma auto-layouts and variable design tokens, along with leveraging generative AI tools (Midjourney, Relume, Galileo) for accelerated ideation and prototyping.
highlights: Master Figma from basics to advanced nested auto-layouts and interactive component variants
Build 3 complete portfolio case studies published on Behance & Notion
Learn how to collaborate smoothly with frontend React and Flutter engineers
AI-assisted wireframing and user research synthesis
courses.prerequisites: Zero coding required! A creative eye and interest in how digital apps and websites work is all you need.
targetAudience: Students and creative individuals seeking a high-paying tech career without writing code
Graphic designers transitioning to digital product and mobile app design
Developers wishing to dramatically improve their user interface aesthetics and UX decisions

curriculum.handsOnProject: End-to-End Published Behance Case Study with Interactive Prototype

courses.title: AI-Powered Mobile App Development Internship
courses.headline: Build Production iOS & Android Apps Powered by Generative AI & Cloud APIs
courses.shortDescription: Master Flutter, React Native, Firebase, and Gemini LLM APIs. Work directly on live client projects at VGM Soft Tech in Coimbatore.
courses.fullDescription: The flagship practical internship at VGM Skill Hub designed to take college students and fresh graduates from coding fundamentals to building, testing, and publishing real AI-augmented cross-platform mobile apps. You will collaborate in Git teams, shadow senior developers on live client projects, integrate streaming LLMs, computer vision, and speech recognition, and publish a capstone app to the Google Play Store.
highlights: Real client project work on VGM Soft Tech enterprise codebases
Official Experience Letter & Certificate with online credential verification
1-on-1 code reviews and technical mock interviews with Senior Staff Engineers
courses.prerequisites: Basic knowledge of any programming language (C, Java, Python, or JavaScript). No prior mobile app experience required.
targetAudience: Engineering & BCA/B.Sc/MCA students seeking mandatory or career internships
Fresh graduates looking for verifiable production experience
Web developers transitioning to cross-platform mobile & AI engineering

curriculum.description: Set up Flutter, React Native, Git/GitHub, and configure developer copilots (Cursor, Gemini CLI, Claude) for rapid scaffold development.

curriculum.description: Connect REST and WebSocket endpoints, implement Gemini 1.5 Flash streaming, speech-to-text, and image classification directly in the mobile UI.

curriculum.title: Cloud Backend, Auth & Real-Time Sync
curriculum.description: Architect a serverless backend using Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Functions, and push notifications.
curriculum.handsOnProject: Full-stack Collaborative Task & AI Team Workspace App

curriculum.title: Live Client Project, Optimization & Play Store Release
curriculum.description: Join a live VGM Soft Tech sprint, adhere to Git PR workflows, optimize app bundle size, run automated UI tests, and release to Google Play.
curriculum.handsOnProject: Production-ready Capstone App deployed to Google Play with full documentation
